notes:
# Transcripts in almost any language {globe}
Choose from nearly 100 languages for transcription, not just 10. Your
Mac's own language is offered first, and languages the speech model is
weaker in are marked.

# Webinar handouts, even when shared late {doc.on.doc}
A webinar has no Resources button until the host shares the first
handout. RecordLah now keeps checking every two minutes until one
appears, so a handout shared late is still saved.

---

Everything else in this release:

- The recording page no longer points at a switch it doesn't have when
  handouts are off.
